# Latest Pilot Jobs

> > Latest Pilot Jobs is a global aviation recruitment platform connecting pilots, cabin crew, and aviation engineers with employers worldwide.

Latest Pilot Jobs operates an international job board featuring thousands of aviation vacancies across pilot, cabin crew, flight attendant, and maintenance engineer positions. The platform serves both job seekers and recruiters with tools including CV databases, interview preparation courses, aptitude testing, and profile matching by aircraft type.

## Job Search & Listings

- [Latest Pilot Jobs - Homepage](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/): Main domain homepage for Latest Pilot Jobs aviation recruitment platform.
- [Job Listings](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/jobs/index.html): Job listings page featuring pilot, cabin crew, and aviation engineer positions worldwide.
- [Pilot Profile Database](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/profile/list.html): Pilot profile database searchable by aircraft types for recruiters and employers.

## Recruiter & Employer Tools

- [Recruiters Site](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/site/recruiters.html): Recruiter platform for posting aviation jobs with membership plans and CV search.

## Interview Preparation & Assessment

- [Airline Interview Preparation](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/interviews/index.html): Subscription-based airline interview preparation courses and assessment materials.
- [Pilot Aptitude Test](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/aptitudetest/index.html): Pre-employment aptitude assessment tool for pilot recruitment and flight school prep.

## Career Resources

- [Curriculum Vitae and Resume Example for Pilots](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/site/mypage/id/curriculum-vitae-example.html): Free CV and resume templates for airline, corporate, and low-time pilots.
- [Cover Letter Example for Pilots](http://www.latestpilotjobs.com/site/mypage/id/cover-letter-example.html): Free cover letter templates for various pilot career types and applications.
